family.seed: Every retained tile whose order divides 55440.

method.extension: Repeatedly add the remaining source-pinned tile with the largest exact gap delta from its strongest mandatory edge to the current tree. Break ties by smaller order, prime, and anchor. Stop before the first nonpositive total gap.
method.proof_rule: For any shifted cover by the certificate tiles, the mandatory spanning-tree edges present at a point are at most its covering multiplicity minus one. Their exact integrated mass must therefore be at most total multiplicity excess.

nonclaims: This is not an unbiased discovery episode because the 188-tile candidate and positive gap were seen in unretained exploratory work.
The excluded family is an algorithmically selected subset of the pinned pool, not the whole 313-tile pool.
The result says nothing about covers using any tile outside the certificate family.
This does not resolve Erdos problem 203 globally or establish novelty.
This producer analysis is not a Vela Verification or human Decision, and it changes no scientific Standing.

preknowledge.disclosure: An unretained deterministic extension of the qualified 55440 tree selected 188 of 313 pinned tiles and retained a strictly positive exact tree-mass gap.
preknowledge.effect: The iteration receives no Claim credit. The retained value is source-first independent qualification of a substantially broader bounded exclusion.

stopping_rule: After this preregistration is committed, run the frozen producer once and the source-first independent checker once. Retain no_cover_selected_family only if all 188 tiles match the pinned pool, all 187 tree edges have compatibility index one, the tree is spanning and acyclic, exact Fraction sums match the disclosed candidate, and tree mass strictly exceeds density slack. Any drift or failed check is invalid output.
